info.name: Qualys API (VM/PC)
info.description:
Community-maintained reference collection for Qualys API (VM/PC).

Current coverage: shared authentication, IP asset operations, Host List V2-V6, and Host Update V2. Legacy Host List versions display their published EOS/EOL dates and V6 replacement path. Host Update V2 displays its lifecycle warning without implying an undocumented V6 update action. Additional VMDR and Policy Audit families will be added incrementally.

Authentication defaults to Basic HTTP authentication with {{username}} and {{password}}. For IdP JWT authentication, set {{accessToken}} in your local environment and change this collection's authentication type to Bearer Token.

Use a Qualys API server URL without a trailing slash for {{baseUrl}}. Never commit credentials, access tokens, or tenant response data.

item.name: Hosts
item.description: Host List source: Qualys API (VM and PA) User Guide v10.40, pages 995-1114. Start with the GET requests. Qualys also documents POST for each version; its equivalent form parameters appear under Postman's Body tab and are grouped separately to keep the primary navigation clear. V2-V5 show the published EOS/EOL dates and V6 replacement path in each request description.

The current HTML heading says GET/POST, but its parameter table and every sample use POST; the collection therefore exposes POST only pending a clear published GET example.
